name: Slow synchronous motors
summary: Small slow AC motors that turn at a fixed speed: microwave turntables, clocks, timers and vents.
identify: Small round motors turning a few rpm, often marked 49TYJ or TYC-50, in microwave turntables, oscillating fans, timer switches, ice makers and some heaters. Most run on mains; some on 12 or 24V AC.
test: Plug into its rated AC supply: it should turn slowly and steadily. Many start in either direction, which is normal.
